messages.subject: Byte compile
parts:
Hi All,

Is there a reason 0.9 does not have byte compiling as a default in the
DESCRIPTION? I can do it manually if I download the source or do a
little hack to install_github from the devtools package, but it would
seem easiest in ggplot2's DESCRIPTION unless it is pointless or
detrimental somehow?

Josh

messages.author: 065110cca96a6373
messages.subject: Re: Byte compile
parts:
Just add this:

ByteCompile: true

It may not be documented in Writing R Extensions yet, but I've been
using it for a few months. IIRC it came out shortly after R 2.13 and
I read it in a NEWS file or something. Anyway, looking at it I
partially answered my own question, byte compiling takes appreciably
longer, which while not an issue from my point of view, could strain
things like CRAN or Rforge that are doing it daily for
hundreds/thousands of packages.

Josh
